power.jaymospowers.blinker.desc: The End's step, the one the endermen take, woken in you: you're here, and then you're there, and in the instant between nothing can touch you.
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.starter: Blink (short): 6 blocks along your look, untouchable for half a second
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.ability_1: Blink: up to 12 blocks along your look, short of any wall; untouchable for half a second
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.ability_2: Blink Strike: to the foe you look at, up to 18 blocks off, behind it, and a blow
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.ability_3: Vanish: a burst of blinding smoke; everyone round you is blinded and loses you, and you blink a few steps back, unseen for 5 s
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.ability_4: Sky Drop: take hold of a foe close by and blink with it 14 blocks straight up; you let go and blink back down while it falls
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.mode.name: None
power.jaymospowers.blinker.key.ultimate: Flicker: for 2 s you flicker from foe to foe round you, five blows a second, untouchable throughout
message.jaymospowers.blinker.no_room: No room beside it to step to
message.jaymospowers.blinker.no_sky: No open sky above to drop it from
message.jaymospowers.blinker.too_much: That one won't be carried by the step
